description: OPTIONAL BUT JUSTIFIED. Server-side session store so the backend can REVOKE a session (logout-everywhere, admin suspension) - something a stateless access token cannot do. NOTE: this collection only provides STORAGE. Issuing, signing and validating tokens is entirely the Spring Boot backend's job and is out of scope here. Rows self-expire via a TTL index, so no cleanup job is needed.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the refresh token, NEVER the token itself. A database dump must not yield usable sessions.

expiresAt.description: TTL anchor. A TTL index with expireAfterSeconds: 0 deletes the row automatically once this timestamp passes.

revokedAt.description: Set on explicit logout or admin suspension; a non-null value must fail validation at the backend.

replacedByTokenHash.description: Supports refresh-token rotation and reuse detection.
